title: What is the simplest undecidable Diophantine equation

problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: What is the simplest undecidable Diophantine equation.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: discharged linear_bezout_n axiom (5→4), via principal coefficient ideal over ℤ. Statically verified; build pending quiet host.
builtItems: Proofs/Hilbert10OQ04.lean:205 theorem linear_bezout_n (0 sorry/0 new axiom), replacing former axiom — reduces axiomCount 5→4.
insights: linear_bezout_n (n-variable Bézout: Σ aᵢxᵢ=b solvable over ℤ iff a gcd divides b) is PROVABLE, not axiomatic: solvability ⟺ b ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range a); over the PID ℤ that ideal is principal (generator g), and d=|g| is the gcd. Discharged via Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun + Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator + Ideal.mem_span_singleton.
Original axiom statement was FALSE in the all-zero degenerate case: strict 0<d wrongly excludes (aᵢ=0,b=0) which is solvable with only witness d=0. Corrected to 0≤d — the minimal fix.
